name: RC-B10-0087/2025 – After recital D – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text: Da. whereas the return rate of Algerian nationals from the EU was 10 % in 2024, mostly because Algeria refuses to issue emergency travel documents; whereas under Article 12(4) of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, signatories, including Algeria, are legally obliged to allow their nationals to return to their country of origin;
